program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_b@i | !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & is_c@j, !is_bos@j | !is_b@i)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_b@i & is_c@i & is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j | !is_b@i, !is_b@i)
accept = !is_b & h2_1 | !is_b & h1_1

output accept
